terms.comment: Ancient fish names do not always map onto one modern species. The identifications are ours, matched to Portuguese market names.

phrases.latin: In mēnsīs piscātōriīs lupī jacēbant, aurātae, scombrī, pōlypī bracchiīs porrēctīs
phrases.english: On the fish stalls lay sea bass, gilthead bream, mackerel, octopuses with their arms spread out
